title: Counter

fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page backgrounds, navigation, text-on-dark, and light button surfaces

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Display headings, navigation, body copy, icons, dark media panels, and hairline graphic details

palette.name: Near Black
palette.role: Secondary dark text and headings where pure Ink is not used

palette.name: Quiet Graphite
palette.role: Supporting body copy, explanatory text, and subdued interface labels

palette.name: Soft Gray
palette.role: Muted metadata, inactive supporting text, and low-emphasis labels

palette.name: Oat Surface
palette.role: Feature-card surfaces, pale pill buttons, understated separators, and surface outlines

palette.name: Ledger Brown
palette.role: Filled pill buttons and dark navigation controls — the brown-black fill keeps conversion controls tactile rather than corporate-blue

palette.name: Espresso Panel
palette.role: Dark product-demo surfaces, data-led card backgrounds, and high-contrast visual blocks

palette.name: Copper Link
palette.role: Inline product-card links and compact interface highlights — a warm cue that reads as commerce material rather than a universal brand wash

palette.name: Terracotta Disc
palette.role: Large circular decorative card accents and isolated graphic moments

palette.name: Active Green
palette.role: Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Active Green Surface
palette.role: Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Pending Ochre
palette.role: Yellow text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Expiry Red
palette.role: Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

layoutText: The page is a white, full-bleed editorial composition with a fixed-height top navigation bar and generous unruled white space around the opening message. The hero uses a wide text composition: an oversized left-aligned headline, a narrower explanatory and conversion block to the right, then a broad contained payment photograph with 16px corners. Product content moves through a dark horizontal media selector, a centered customer-logo strip, and a two-row five-column payment-capability grid before splitting into paired cream feature cards. Customer stories use a wide three-panel horizontal carousel with image-first cards and centered quote text below, followed by large dark product-media sections; the footer returns to a dense multi-link structure.
imageryText: Photography is central and product-adjacent: hands using phones, countertop terminals, retail environments, and customer scenes are shown as warm, natural-color crops rather than stock-office portraits. Images are wide, contained, and softly rounded at 16px, with occasional dark translucent payment overlays or circular arrow controls placed directly on the image. The page is text-led between media moments, while customer logos and sparse monochrome line icons provide the non-photographic visual layer. Dark product demonstrations use realistic interface fragments, data, and device screens as explanatory content rather than abstract fintech decoration.
rules:
### Do
- Use Paper #ffffff as the dominant canvas and reserve Oat Surface #f7f4f1 for contained cards and secondary pill controls.
- Set display headlines in Inter Variable 82px/400, 82px line-height, and -2.4px tracking.
- Use IBM Plex Mono uppercase labels at 13px/500 with 16.9px line-height above product and media content.
- Use Ledger Brown #3b281d only for filled public pill buttons with 9999px radius and 16px 24px padding.
- Give product cards and media frames a 16px radius; use 24px only for larger image and media treatments.
- Use Copper Link #e07122 for inline product-card links and small commerce-oriented highlights.
- Keep the default page rhythm on the 4px base unit, using 10px element gaps and 32px section gaps.

### Don't
- Do not use blue #0040ff or browser-default #0000ee as a brand or button color.
- Do not turn the Ledger Brown #3b281d filled treatment into a square button; public conversion controls use 9999px radius.
- Do not use heavy outer drop shadows on cards; cards use no shadow and rely on Oat Surface #f7f4f1, borders, and rounded media.
- Do not use bold 600-700 weights for the 82px display role; retain Inter Variable 400.
- Do not replace IBM Plex Mono uppercase labels with Inter body text.
- Do not apply Terracotta Disc #d66733 as a broad page background or universal action color.
- Do not use status colors outside compact payment and account-state contexts.
adaptation: Fictional copy and credited stock hero photography; no source brand logos or proprietary assets.
